title: ARCADE: ONE-BUTTON QUICK HEAL
why: His yes to the five recommendations for the Halloween party mode, arcade23. Healing meant putting the heal on the belt and then firing, which a walk-up player never finds. In an arcade raid G on the keyboard and D-DOWN on the controller now heal at once with what you carry, by the same rules as every heal: the cheapest heal that still helps, the same wind-up bar, and his ruling that a Bandage stops at 85 and only a Medkit reaches 100. The controls card at every drop shows it on the HEAL row. Down, the buttons keep their old jobs. Normal raids are untouched: G still uses the selected belt item.
now: In the arcade G on the keyboard and D-DOWN on the controller heal at once with what you carry, and the controls card shows it.
